purpose: Teach: キミ/ハズ/みどり/蹴り/お許し/かんじ/はかり/相方

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「キミ」と私を呼んで下さった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to call me by my name so gently.
lines.style: Soft, faraway gaze into memory. Voice warm but thin with age and distance. Pause before speaking, as if reaching back many years.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お孫様が来るハズだって楽しみにしてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and your father was so pleased when he heard you'd be coming to visit, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle correction wrapped in affection. Warm, present, slightly teasing. A wife's way of drawing him back to the room.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお庭のみどりを大事にされた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he tended the garden with such care.
lines.style: The same faraway tone. Voice settles deeper into the memory. Slight pause at the image of it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、サッカーボールを蹴り回されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather used to kick a soccer ball all over that yard when he was young, don't you remember, dear?
lines.style: Playful counterpoint. Light, almost laughing at him. A gentle tease of affection — reminding him of his own youth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「お許しを」と丁寧に頭を下げられた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he'd bow so deeply when he asked forgiveness.
lines.style: Voice softens further. The weight of that politeness, that humility, lingers. Barely a whisper at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、季節の移ろいをかんじてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather noticed the turning of the seasons, didn't he, dear? Always watching the sky.
lines.style: Affirming, tender. A wife speaking what she knows to be true. Her voice carries the certainty of a lifetime together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがはかりで野菜の重さを量られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he'd weigh each vegetable so carefully on the scale.
lines.style: Voice grows quieter, almost reverent. The smallest gesture becomes monumental in the telling. A long breath at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、私を生涯の相方として扱われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather chose me as his partner for life, you know. He really did, dear.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Not boastful — just stating what was true between them. Her voice breaks slightly with the weight of that life, now measured in memory.
